1.d4 Nf6 2.Nf3 b6 3.g3 Bb7 4.Bg2 c5 5.c4.strategy: Adds a second pawn to the fight for the centre and prepares to meet the capture on d4 with a recapture by the queen or the knight. White claims queenside space and keeps its pieces ready to take the pawn back.
Takes the pawn, removes White's central pawn and gives Black a half-open c-file for the rook. If White recaptures with the queen, Black has to be ready to gain time against it.
